Actor.description:
Who wrote a record or acted: the session, the program and the person,
each when known, and at least one. Every record type that names who
acted holds one.

person.description: The person who acted, such as `luke`, or their email address.

program.description: The program that acted, such as `claude-code` or `codex`.

Option.description:
One answer the owner may give. An answer's `choice` and the question's
`recommendation` name it by `id`.

id.description: The option's name, unique among the question's options.

text.description: What choosing the option means, in words the owner reads.

description:
`plans/question/v1`: a question an agent session needs the owner to answer.

It lives at `/projects/<project>/questions/<id>`, so its path names its
project. `<id>` is a sortable UTC time and a short random suffix, such as
`20261024T1830Z-k3`. Its answer is a `plans/answer/v1` at
`/projects/<project>/answers/<id>`, with the same id. Never put a secret
value in a question.

blocks.description: What cannot proceed until the question is answered.

by.description:
Who asked. It names the asking session, so the answer can be sent
back to it.

context_path.description: A Markdown file in the board that holds long background.

mount.description:
The mount of the repository the question concerns, such as
`/repos/board`, when there is one.

note.description:
What the asker did not know, such as details nobody has written down
yet.

options.description: The answers the owner may choose from.

recommendation.description: The `id` of the option the asker recommends.

status.description:
`open` while the question stands, and `withdrawn` when it no longer
matters. A question is answered when a `plans/answer/v1` names it in
`question`; its status stays `open`.

withdrawn_reason.description: Why the question was withdrawn, as `plans.withdraw` records it.

title: QuestionRecord
